news.title: In-game overlay panel
news.body: Check instance status, tweak timing, and switch presets without alt-tabbing out of your game. Bind a key to it in Clicker settings.

news.title: A timing model built on real click data
news.body: Calypse Clicker's click intervals aren't a fixed loop — they're generated from a model tuned against real human click-timing data, down to hesitation pauses and fatigue drift.

news.title: Sign in is here
news.body: Calypse now has accounts. This is step one toward the rest of the Calypse toolset — more apps land in this same launcher over time.
